description: CPO objective from §3.2 Eqs. (3) and (5): sequence-summed token log probabilities with a uniform-reference preference term and unit-weight preferred-sequence NLL; beta=0.1 follows §4.2. Structured-objective bindings and scalar loss requirements are in src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50; record fields are converted to floats at :63.

examples.title: Train on paired preference sequences

name: Contrastive Preference Optimization loss

parameters.ignore_index: optional integer token ID excluded from both response sequence log probabilities
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating point logits with shape [B, 2, T, V], preferred response first
parameters.reduction: none per preference pair, mean, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer or integral-valued floating token IDs with shape [B, 2, T]
